hints: For a proportion, the approximate confidence interval is $\hat{p} \pm z\sqrt{\dfrac{\hat{p}(1-\hat{p})}{n}}$. Write it with $\hat{p} = 0.23$ (23% as a decimal) and $n = 200$.

A 93% interval leaves $7\%$ to share between the two tails. Work out how much is in each tail, then find the $z$ whose normal cdf $\Phi(z)$ equals the area to the left of the upper end (inverse normal on your calculator or the tables).
Evaluate the square root $\sqrt{\dfrac{0.23 \times (1-0.23)}{200}}$, multiply it by your $z$, then add it to and subtract it from $0.23$. Give both ends of the interval to 3 s.f.
walkthrough:
**Why this formula**

We know the proportion in the sample, not in the whole college. In the sample, $23\% = 0.23$ owned a car. We write $\hat{p}$ (said 'p-hat') for this sample proportion, so $\hat{p} = 0.23$. The sample size is $n = 200$.

Because $n$ is large, the sample proportion is approximately normal, with standard deviation $\sqrt{\dfrac{\hat{p}(1-\hat{p})}{n}}$ (we use $\hat{p}$ because we do not know the true proportion). An approximate confidence interval goes $z$ of these standard deviations either side of $\hat{p}$:

$$\hat{p} \pm z\sqrt{\frac{\hat{p}(1-\hat{p})}{n}}$$

**Write the interval with our numbers (this is the M1)**

$$0.23 \pm z \times \sqrt{\frac{0.23 \times (1 - 0.23)}{200}}$$

This line, with any value of $z$, earns the M1. Be careful: if you use $z = 0.8328$ the scheme gives B0M0.

**Find $z$ (this is the B1)**

A 93% interval sits in the middle of the normal curve. That leaves $100\% - 93\% = 7\%$ in the two tails, so $3.5\%$ in each tail.

The area to the left of the upper end is $1 - 0.035 = 0.965$. So we need the $z$ with $\Phi(z) = 0.965$.

On your calculator use inverse normal (area $0.965$, mean $0$, standard deviation $1$):

$$z = 1.8119\ldots \approx 1.812$$

Common slip: typing $0.93$ into the inverse normal. That would give $z = 1.476$, which is the value for a different (86%) interval.

**Work out the margin either side of 0.23**

$$1.812 \times 0.029757 = 0.053920\ldots$$

**Find both ends (this is the A1)**

Lower end:

$$0.23 - 0.05392 = 0.17608\ldots$$

Upper end:

$$0.23 + 0.05392 = 0.28392\ldots$$

The scheme says the answer **must be an interval**, so write both ends, each to 3 significant figures.

**Final answer**

The approximate 93% confidence interval for the proportion is $0.176$ to $0.284$ (3 s.f.).
